request.style: English, desert rock, gritty male vocal, fuzzy baritone guitar, droning bass, tom-heavy drums, sparse and tense, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Forty days in the wilderness, forty nights alone
Sun like a hammer and sand like a bone
Then a voice came out of the heat haze, smooth as oil
If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread

[Chorus]
It is written
Man shall not live by bread alone
But by every word that comes from the mouth of God
It is written

[Verse]
Up on the temple's edge, the city far below
Throw yourself down, the angels will catch you, you know
Up on the mountain, all the kingdoms shining bright
All of this is yours if you bow down tonight

[Chorus]
It is written
Man shall not live by bread alone
But by every word that comes from the mouth of God
It is written

[Bridge]
Away with you, Satan
You shall worship the Lord your God
And him alone shall you serve
Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came

[Outro]
It is written
